title: Data Engineer - Snowflake, Data Modeling/Pipelines, Orchestration, Exp: 4-8 Yrs
teaser: We are recruiting a Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines and models within Snowflake, supporting critical sales applications. You will collaborate with a skilled team to deliver impactful data solutions. Ideal candidates have 4–8 years’ experience in data engineering and expertise in Python, SQL, and cloud data warehouses.
description:
Meet the Team

 Join a dynamic and impactful team responsible for the critical sales applications (My Business Reports (MBR), Intelligence center, One Sales BO (OSBO), and Visibility) that drive Cisco's success. This team is at the forefront of leveraging data to provide unparalleled insights into sales performance, operational efficiency, and market visibility through AI-led data management and analysis. You will collaborate with dedicated professionals who are passionate about transforming data into actionable intelligence.
 

Your Impact

• Build Data Pipelines to ingest data into Snowflake and lead data access on snowflake

• Define and advocate standard processes for AI-led data storage and analysis within Snowflake.

• Review the Data Modeling practices

• Build reporting dashboards and visualizations to design, create, and track campaign/program KPIs

• Drive data warehouse architecture design, modeling and ETL development according to privacy compliance requirements.

• Support other allied architecture and integration activities. Assist in developing documentation around system integration, data flows, data dictionary, user guides and standard processes.

• Experience using tech solutions like Git, Gradle, Airflow, and Kubernetes to craft & deploy apps and jobs on cloud-hosted services
 

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelors degree or equivalent 4-8 years related experience

• Experience using Python and SQL

• Experience with Building Data Pipelines in Python

• Experience with any Cloud Data Warehouse either as an Administrator or a Developer
 

Preferred Qualifications

• Proficiency in data modeling, data design, SQL, and NoSQL databases

• Proven background in algorithms and data structures

• Experience working with PII and GDPR data

• Proven communication and partnership contribute to multi-functional teams.

Who You'll Work With

You will be an integral part of the My Business Reports (MBR), Visibility and OSBO team, working alongside a group of passionate and highly skilled professionals who consistently go above and beyond to meet ambitious targets and deliverables. In the MBR team, we thrive on challenges, and you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across the product’s tech stack, including data scientists and AI specialists.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, data engineering, business analysts, and senior leadership, to drive the design and implementation of high-impact, AI-powered data solutions.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
